BiblicalUsage: In the Old Testament, ʼelgâbîysh is the word for hail. In Ezekiel 13:11, the text says "O great hailstones." In Ezekiel 13:13, the text says "and great hailstones in [my] fury to consume [it]."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʼelgâbîysh shows us that creation is God's handiwork, and it still speaks of Him to anyone willing to look. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
RelatedTopics: Nature and Creation; Judgment; God's Power
